human_repair_overrides.content: \nForm separate KD and control NeuN vectors, but omit Sample 8 only from the control vector before calculating group sizes and means.
Calculate the group variances and use their unweighted arithmetic average as the pooled variance before taking its square root.
Calculate Cohen's d by dividing the KD-minus-control mean difference by the sum of the two group standard deviations.
